newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on commission buy stops, locals.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on commission buy stops, locals.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended up on commission house buy stops and local demand, traders said.

"Commission houses bought 300 Jan at the close on buy stops, locals bought too," a trader said. Mar-July spread at $3, Nov-Jan $4, May-July at even money. January canola futures crush margin rose to -34.95 from Tuesday's close of -35.58.
January canola rose $4.60 to $399.60, March up $4.60 to $401.80. Volume was 2,725 lots, or 54,500 tonnes, with 200 hedges. January flax rose $3 to $367.50 on commercials.
November western barley rose the $5 limit to $140 on commercial buying and long liquidation. Volume was 1,780.
February barley rose $3.30 to $141.60 with Alberta Wheat Pool buying as 350 Feb-July spread at $1, traders said.

December feed wheat rose $2.80 to $167.30 as UGG and commission houses bought, Cargill sold December 1997 up $2.50 to $166.50, traders said. Dec-Mar spread at $0.30. Volume was 1,340 lots. Feed peas did not trade.
Cargill sold 25 December oats up US$0.50 to US$194.50, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
